pairs.subject: module-design
pairs.evidence: core/src/main/kotlin/dev/telestrator/core/TransportPlan.kt:30 Transport planning accepts a project-owned closed command vocabulary as unrestricted text and silently ignores unknown commands, leaving accepted values outside the checked interface.

techniques.evidence: core/src/main/kotlin/dev/telestrator/core/History.kt:25 History keeps its deque private and exposes explicit operations; inspection and searches found no implicit surface forwarding or dependency-category disjointness premise in the context.
core/src/main/kotlin/dev/telestrator/core/PenConversation.kt:182 Timeout decisions receive time and return effects; coroutine launches, delays and execution of those effects reside in PenSessionHost.

core/src/main/kotlin/dev/telestrator/core/Timeline.kt:28 Moment grouping uses an explicit loop because accepting the next anchor depends on the last accepted anchor; the preceding projection and sorting remain declarative.
core/build.gradle.kts:3 The module uses compiler-provided serialization generation; source and build inspection found no exported generator splicing authored names into a caller's scope.

core/src/main/kotlin/dev/telestrator/core/PenConversation.kt:135 The core calculates a deadline from supplied time instead of driving a host timer; searches found no owned spawn, sleep or runtime-timeout calls requiring a facade.

core/src/main/kotlin/dev/telestrator/core/PenConversation.kt:156 Malformed input executes an injected callback inside onText instead of returning a diagnostic effect; PenSessionHost supplies Log.w, so this path performs logging during the core transition.

core/src/test/kotlin/dev/telestrator/core/PenConversationTest.kt:255 Tests construct heartbeat inputs directly from ordinary values; inspected core entry points do not require a host-minted input that tests cannot construct.

core/src/main/kotlin/dev/telestrator/core/TransportPlan.kt:30 plan branches on a fixed set of project-owned command strings and returns emptyList for everything else, matching the standard's closed vocabulary represented by an open type failure.

core/src/main/kotlin/dev/telestrator/core/PenConversation.kt:94 Connections retain the original PairingDesk reference; searches and source inspection found no runner lane that copies an existing shared carrier across a fork or worker boundary.
